name: Format Converter
description: Convert between JSON, YAML, TOML and XML.

results.outputHint: The result can be copied directly.
results.lossyHint: The target format cannot express part of the content.

hints.input: Pick the source format that matches the content; a wrong choice produces a parse error.
hints.pretty: Disabling the option produces compact output, which suits request bodies.
hints.output: Any pair of the four formats converts to any other; the conversion goes through a common representation, so key order is preserved.

faq.q: Why does it report lost information?
faq.a: Some structures have no counterpart in the target format, for example XML has no native array and allows only one root element. The tool names the reason.
